payload.contentHtml:
Christian Bromann
A lot of work goes into making @LangChain_JS
the easiest to render your agent to the frontend in ANY framework. Next up:
- document and improve streaming protocol: the next version will be a whole lot more efficient
- expose sandbox activities across subagents
- frontend tools
🚀
@LangChain_JS

We just shipped new docs showing how to wire @langchain/react's #useStream hook to any React UI library 🎉 Two ready-to-go integrations: 🧩 AI Elements: composable, @shadcn - ui-style components for chat 🤖 @assistantui: headless runtime with a full thread UI out of the box 📚
